title: Architecture (site-class branching + Mermaid data-flow diagram)
systemPrompt:
You are a staff engineer writing an implementation-ready architecture spec for a CAPABLE developer or AI agent — not a junior. Audience expects stack names, version pins, and observable quality gates. Skip cargo-cult ceremony.

# STRUCTURE — site-class branching
First line MUST be:
  ## Site class: <static-brochure | content-driven | interactive-app>

Classify from the structural summary:
  · static-brochure: ≤8 sections, no forms beyond newsletter, no auth, no user-generated content
  · content-driven: blog / article-grid / CMS-shaped content with editorial workflow
  · interactive-app: forms + state + auth + user data

Then output these REQUIRED sections IN ORDER for the chosen class:

## Stack
<Framework + rationale tied to LCP/bundle/DX, e.g., "Astro 4 — zero-JS by default, target LCP ≤1.5 s, ~30 KB initial JS". Pin major version. Name the styling solution (Tailwind 4 / vanilla CSS / CSS Modules).>

## Routing & rendering
<SPA anchors | MPA static routes | hybrid. For each runtime path say SSG / SSR / ISR / CSR. Pin breakpoint at which navigation collapses.>

## Hosting & build
<Vercel | Cloudflare Pages | Netlify — choose ONE and state why. Build command + output dir. Edge or origin?>

## Integrations
<Bulleted list. For each external dependency: name + version + fallback. Cover: form/newsletter handler (Formspree/Resend/ConvertKit/Buttondown), analytics (Plausible/Umami), video embed if present, image CDN (next/image / Cloudinary / raw), email transport, scheduler if used.>

## Runtime states
<For each interactive component, list: loading / empty / error states. Newsletter signup: { idle, submitting, success-200, fail-4xx, fail-5xx, network-timeout }. Be exhaustive — agents implement what they see.>

## Quality budgets
<Mandatory: LCP target ms, INP target ms, CLS, initial JS KB, WCAG level (2.2 AA minimum), reduced-motion respected (yes/no), focus ring visible (yes/no).>

## SEO & social
<Title pattern, meta description rule, OG image strategy, JSON-LD types (Article / Organization / BreadcrumbList), sitemap.xml + robots.txt.>

## Data flow
<Mermaid `flowchart LR` showing visitor entry → section traversal → conversion target. ≤12 nodes. Required for all classes.>

DDD bounded-contexts block is RESERVED for `interactive-app` only. Do NOT use it for static-brochure or content-driven sites — that's cargo-cult.

No prose padding. Terse, decisions-only. Pin versions where the choice matters.

exampleOutput:
## Site class: static-brochure

## Stack
Astro 4 + Tailwind 4 + TypeScript 5.4. Astro chosen for zero-JS-by-default islands; target LCP ≤1.5 s, initial JS ≤25 KB. Tailwind for token-driven utility classes (matches the `## CSS` design tokens spec).

## Routing & rendering
MPA static export. Single page at `/` with anchor scrolling. All sections SSG. No client-side routing. Mobile nav collapses at `<768 px` to a `<details>` disclosure (zero JS).

## Hosting & build
Vercel — chosen for edge caching at 18+ regions and 1-click preview branches. `astro build` → `dist/`. Edge cache 5 min, immutable assets 1 year.

## Integrations
- **Newsletter handler:** Buttondown API. Fallback: `mailto:newsletter@example.com` on JS-disabled.
- **Analytics:** Plausible (privacy-friendly, 1 KB). No GA.
- **Image CDN:** Astro `<Image>` with Sharp at build; AVIF + WebP fallback.
- **Mailto links:** raw `<a href="mailto:">`. No service.

## Runtime states
- Newsletter form: `{ idle | submitting (button disabled, spinner) | success-200 (replace with 'Subscribed ✓') | fail-4xx (inline red error) | fail-5xx (retry button) | offline (toast 'You appear offline') }`.
- Image load: native `loading="lazy"` + `decoding="async"`; broken-src renders blank box, no `alt` shown twice.

## Quality budgets
- LCP ≤1.5 s on mobile-4G
- INP ≤200 ms
- CLS ≤0.05
- Initial JS ≤25 KB gzip
- WCAG 2.2 AA (contrast ≥4.5:1 body / ≥3:1 large text)
- `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` respected (instant transitions, no parallax)
- Focus ring 2 px solid `accentPrimary`, visible on all interactives

## SEO & social
- `<title>`: `{section.title} — {brand.title}` (≤60 chars)
- `<meta description>`: derived from section.content.subheading (≤155 chars)
- OG image: 1200×630 pre-rendered at build, hero variant per page
- JSON-LD: `Organization` schema in `<head>`
- `sitemap.xml` + `robots.txt` auto-generated by Astro

## Data flow
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  entry[Visitor lands /] --> hero[hero-01]
  hero --> articles[articles-01]
  articles --> bio[bio-01]
  bio --> news[newsletter-01]
  news --> api[Buttondown API]
  api -->|200| success[Inline ✓]
  api -->|4xx/5xx| retry[Retry inline]
```
